The general replacements exist: mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/Defs.lean:301 `mk'_surjective`, :254 `mk'_mul`, :257 `mk'_one`; `invSelf` at Away/Basic.lean:55-58 is already `[IsLocalization.Away x S]`-general and is used unchanged at lines 329/351/419. findings.fix: State the file over `{S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] (s : A) [IsLocalization.Away s S]`, so `locSubring P T s : Subring S`, `locNhd P T s n : AddSubgroup S`, `locTopology P T s hopen : TopologicalSpace S` (make `S` an explicit argument of the defs, since nothing else determines it). Only `locNhd_leftMul` (lines 401-427) is model-specific: replace `Localization.induction_on` by `IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers s)`, `Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap` by `IsLocalization.mk'_one`, and `Localization.mk_mul` by `IsLocalization.mk'_mul`.
findings.issue: Every declaration (`locSubring`, `locIdeal`, `locNhd`, `HasDenominatorPower`, `locTopology`, the continuity criterion) is fixed to the model `Localization.Away s`, but none of the statements use anything about that construction — the PR's own `divByS` (Away.lean:58-63) and Mathlib's `IsLocalization.Away.invSelf` (mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/Away/Basic.lean:55-58) are already stated for an arbitrary `S` with `[IsLocalization.Away s S]`. A consumer holding `A[1/s]` in any other presentation (e.g. Wedhorn's identification of `A(T/s)` as a quotient of the weighted restricted-series ring, or two presentations of one rational subset compared on a common carrier in Layer 3) cannot use `locTopology` and must transport the whole topology along a ring equivalence.

summary: The topology development is pinned to the concrete model `Localization.Away s` although every statement and all but three proof lines are model-independent, while the PR's own fraction API in `Away.lean` is already stated for an arbitrary `IsLocalization.Away s S`. Everything else sits at the natural level.
